jurisdiction: Red Sea / Gulf of Aden / global shipping

claims.claim: Red Sea security incidents have increased routing risk and contributed to vessel diversions and higher shipping-risk costs.

sources.name: IMO Maritime Security Advisories
supports: Provides official maritime security advisory context for high-risk sea lanes.
limits: Advisories are not a complete incident database and may not quantify insurance costs.

sources.name: IMF PortWatch trade disruption monitor
supports: Tracks shipping and port-flow disruptions that can indicate rerouting pressure.
limits: Port-flow indicators are aggregate signals and need interpretation for specific routes.

sources.name: Drewry World Container Index
supports: Provides a market benchmark for container freight-rate pressure.
limits: Freight rates reflect multiple drivers, not only Red Sea security risk.

unsupported_claims: Exact number of vessels attacked per week in 2026-Q2 without a current incident database.
source_plan: Check IMO and UKMTO maritime security advisories
Compare freight and insurance market benchmarks before attributing causality
